scenes.narration: Welcome to Panta Rooms — the social way to call what happens next.
scenes.caption: Welcome to Panta Rooms — the social way to call what happens next.

scenes.narration: This is Panta Rooms — a social layer on top of Panta's prediction markets. Every card is a real question people are trading on right now. Browsing is free. And when you're ready to trade with real USDC, you connect your wallet right up here.
scenes.caption: Browsing is free. Connect your Solana wallet (top right) when you're ready to trade real USDC.

scenes.narration: In Explore, markets are sorted into ten categories — sports, crypto, politics, and more. Filter by open or resolved, or search for anything. Prices move with real trading, so the crowd's opinion is always on the card.
scenes.caption: Ten categories. Open/resolved filters. Prices move with real trading.

scenes.narration: Open any market to enter its Room — part market, part conversation. Scroll down to the discussion, type your take, and post it. You can comment as a guest, no wallet needed. Your comment appears instantly, and sorting and reactions keep the conversation tidy.
scenes.caption: Every Room has a discussion. Post as a guest — no wallet needed.

scenes.narration: Every take counts. The Community tab ranks the most-discussed rooms and the loudest voices — this week, or all time. Post takes in any market to climb the board.
scenes.caption: The Community board ranks the most-discussed Rooms and the loudest voices.

scenes.narration: Not ready to spend? One click. Open the environment chip and switch to Demo mode — sample data, clearly labeled, and the full experience with zero setup.
scenes.caption: Switch to Demo mode: the full experience with zero setup.

scenes.narration: Let's create a Room. Type any question, and the AI structures it into a proper prediction market. Review the details, tweak the description, pick a category, then create. In demo mode it's instant and free.
scenes.caption: Type any question — AI structures it into a market. Free in demo.

scenes.narration: Now make the call. Pick YES or NO, choose your amount, get a live quote, and confirm. In demo you're trading sample funds — but the mechanics are exactly what you'd use on mainnet.
scenes.caption: Pick a side, get a quote, confirm. Same mechanics as mainnet.

scenes.narration: And that's the whole loop. Explore, discuss, predict, and climb the board. Panta Rooms — every question can become a market. The link is right below this video.
scenes.caption: Explore. Discuss. Predict. panta-rooms.vercel.app
